certificates.title: Ethical Hacking
certificates.description: Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) is a qualification obtained by demonstrating knowledge of assessing the security of computer systems by looking for weaknesses and vulnerabilities in target systems, using the same knowledge and tools as a malicious hacker, but in a lawful and legitimate manner to assess the security posture of a target system.

certificates.title: ISO 27001: 2022 Lead Auditor
certificates.description: The ISO 27001 Lead Auditor training course enables participants to develop the expertise needed to audit an Information Security Management System (ISMS) based on ISO/IEC 27001 and to manage a team of auditors by applying widely recognized audit principles, procedures, and techniques.

certificates.title: CSSLP
certificates.description: Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP) is a certification aimed at ensuring security is considered throughout the software development lifecycle. CSSLP professionals are trained in application security, secure design principles, and compliance issues.

certificates.title: CISSP
certificates.description: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) is a certification for information technology security professionals. It is created by the International Information System Security Certification Consortium, also known as (ISC)², a non-profit organization which specializes in information security education and certifications.

certificates.title: Certified Cloud Security Professional
certificates.description: The Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) certification is designed for experienced IT professionals who are responsible for cloud security architecture, design, operations, or service orchestration.

certificates.title: iPAS Security L1
certificates.image: /images/certifications/ipas/iPas 資安工程師-初級能力檢定.png
certificates.description: The Industrial Professional Assessment System (iPAS) certification for information security is designed to evaluate an individual's capability in information security protection and technical implementation.
certificates.fullName: Information Security Engineer Professional Certification - Level 1
